remarks: LONG-TERM LEASE ONLY. Preferably two years. Available as of August 1st. Furnished or unfurnished. Nestled behind privacy gates in the heart of Westport's coveted Long Lots neighborhood, 101 Roseville Road presents a grand center hall Colonial that seamlessly blends timeless elegance with modern luxury. Built in 2007, this stately residence spans 5,955 square feet across four finished levels, offering ample space for both intimate gatherings and grand entertaining. Upon entering, you're greeted by a sun-drenched interior filled with natural light, accentuating the home's open floor plan. The updated kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and finishes that cater to culinary enthusiasts. Adjacent to the kitchen, multiple living areas provide versatile spaces for relaxation and socializing.  This exquisite property boasts five generously sized bedrooms and seven bathrooms (five full and two partial), ensuring comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. The primary suite is a sanctuary, complete with a lavish en-suite bathroom and an expansive walk-in closet designed to accommodate even the most extensive wardrobe.
